g.text: RJ45: Shuri / Talokan / Asgard / Knowhere; order unknown
VLANs / separate networks on shared cables
XCP-ng hosts, Shuri, NAS and guests
How VLANs travel through this topology
One cable carries multiple VLANs. Tags identify the network; Default is native.
Servers native + tags blocked; all five hosts send untagged frames.
Asgard/Knowhere keep VLAN 10 inside OVS; eth1 is access VLAN 10.
UDR7 firewall policy controls traffic between networks. A trunk is not permission.
